alignment_definition.interpretation: attention-alignment / spatial-correspondence analysis; not a causal explanation
alignment_definition.mask_resize: deterministic area averaging onto the native attention grid
alignment_definition.normalization: DSA attention must already have unit spatial mass within absolute tolerance 1e-06; resized consensus is normalized to unit mass

kl.direction: KL(consensus spatial distribution || DSA attention distribution)
kl.relationship_to_training: same direction as Phase 4 attention alignment loss

alignment_definition.continuous_correlation: Pearson correlation across flattened spatial cells; null for a constant map
alignment_definition.continuous_overlap: sum of elementwise minima of the two unit-mass distributions

dice_iou.attention_foreground: attention >= its per-map 0.90 quantile using NumPy linear interpolation

prior: training-only: area-resize each mask, normalize each to unit mass, arithmetic nodule mean, normalize numerical drift once

bootstrap.estimand: nodule-mean paired alignment difference per trained seed
bootstrap.missing_correlation: pairwise defined nodules only; preserve full patient draws, omit empty-defined replicates and report counts

panel.cases: flagged plus low/lower-median/high mean CDX Dice across all three seeds; ascending value then nodule_id; deduplicate with reasons
panel.display: CT clipped to [0,1]; consensus [0,1]; attention/prior divided by each map maximum for display only; nearest grid upsampling; alpha=0.5

interpretation: spatial correspondence only; not causal explanation, not an attention-loss ablation, no superiority or population-wide significance claim
